market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off dominates: rate-hike bets, Iran oil shock, and bond selloff pressure equities and metals. Expect volatility in energy, rates, and EM. AI names may outperform on earnings visibility. 1-3 months: choppy, defensive posture warranted.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle and India capital flows provide structural growth. US debt sustainability and global rate normalization are key 6-12 month variables. If Fed pivots, gold and equities recover sharply. Hormuz bypass reduces long-term energy risk premium.
